children: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs are on track to post their largest monthly outflow since they launched, Nansen analyst Nicolai Sondergaard says in a research note. The ETFs have shed $4.7 billion in November following another $570 million outflow on Monday, the analyst says. Investors have still put $52 billion more into the funds than they've taken out, so the core of ETF ownership is holding, he says. But the largest holders don't seem to be absorbing the ETF selloff, leaving prices vulnerable to keep moving downward, the analyst says. The exodus appears to be driven by investors cutting risk ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest rate hike, rather than leaving the asset entirely, Sondergaard says. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
